about: Counters read from 'ACHERON EX TOP 1 - Frame Window Counter' (1280x720, 60 fps, 'Vanilla 240 FPS'). Digits decoded from the sidebar at 30 fps (clustering the glyphs, row colours known) and checked by eye against 5 frames. The reference counts clicks only. Its top bucket is labelled 9-10; its CPS readout ('x/5/N CPS', N = clicks so far) shows how many clicks had happened, so clicks that are in no bucket can be derived (N minus the counted ones). The reference macro is not byte-identical to the zBot file (about 193 clicks in the video vs about 201 presses in the results), so compare shares, not single clicks.
